我们在[From.GetName]发现了有趣的东西，不过跟[From.GetPlanetMoon]本身没有什么关系。我们像往常一样进行测试时，突然捕获到一颗遥远的恒星系中的恒星传出的奇怪数据。该恒星的辐射表明，它可以在不发生散裂的情况下让铍原子发生聚变，而这根本就是不可能的！

科学团队已经迫不及待想前去一探究竟了，而且他们已经将范围缩小到两个不是很远的恒星系。
查询情报日志获取细节。
texts.en:
We have made an interesting find on [From.GetName], however it is not related to the [From.GetPlanetMoon] itself. While conducting our usual tests we captured some odd data from a far-off system's star. Its radiation indicates that it is able to fuse together beryllium without spallation; something that should not be possible!

The science team are eager to investigate and have limited the potential stars down to two not-too-distant systems.
Consult the Situation Log for details.
